correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the normalization and its rational inverse, identifies the unique singular point, reduces every projective stabilizer element to a PGL_2 automorphism fixing the unique normalization point over the singularity, and solves the exact linear-series preservation equations. The resulting transformations preserve the quartic polynomial identically in characteristic 2, obey the additive group law, and act by translations on an affine coordinate of the normalization complement. The verifier checks every critical polynomial identity symbolically; no finite enumeration is used as a substitute for the algebraically closed-field quantifier.

value.rationale: The result is a structural description of a distinguished member of a universal characteristic-two quartic family: it upgrades the source’s tangent-line geometry to global projective homogeneity. Identifying the smooth locus as a single simply transitive G_a orbit explains the curve as an equivariant compactification and determines all plane symmetries, rather than computing an arbitrary numerical invariant or a routine specialization.
